items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I got to meet a lot of wonderful musicians, Bob Mintzer was there.

ctx.x: It doesn’t sound like you from what I can tell. You’ve gotten to play with Dick Hyman and Dave Grusin, was this workshops?

This was a workshop, yeah, this is one I did last year, last summer at the Henry Mancini Institute. It was a month long. It was great. I got to meet a lot of wonderful musicians, Bob Mintzer was there. There was a whole philharmonic. So it was the first year that they had the workshop. And I thought it was a great, wonderful workshop, to be able to meet — just like the Jazz in July and the Vermont Summer Workshop, being able to meet top people in the field, and being able to perform along with them. And so they…
Do you have a business card?
